scope.engineTrace: recorded in _work/map-laps/usa_amboy/engine-trace.json; not re-run by this builder
scope.note: a data layout, not an e1-drive integration: no gate mesh, no race director, no lap timing, no car simulated

source.groundSource: loops.json loop-01 `ground`: the P48 collision raster H at each 0.25 m sample's 0.5 m cell (4 decimals)
source.gateLineSource: 5 m tangent window across the loop, 4 m line, oriented so the approach side is positive (sprint-layout.js rule)
source.checkpointStationSource: samples closest to one-third / two-thirds of the measured arc; the probe layout's 379/759 are nominal 0.25 m sample thirds (32.77 % / 65.66 %)
source.spawnSource: loop-01 first sample from _work/map-laps/usa_amboy/loops.json; not a retail start line

course.rule: the lap follows map-laps loop-01 (284.4524 m, 1152 samples at 0.25 m) exactly; the start/finish line sits on the first measured sample and is perpendicular to the 5 m tangent across the seam; three forward crossings of that line end the race
course.name: usa_amboy map-laps loop-01

span.note: arc lengths are measured along the closed loop-01; lap N ends at the next forward crossing of arc 0 and the timer is the engine tick clock from GO

corridor.rule: off-course respawn band is a declared +/-1.498 m around the measured loop line

source.note: declared respawn rule = car half-width 1.138 m + 0.36 m margin; the River 1.25 m bound was 0.01 m too tight on the measured Amboy driven run at arc 182.5, and the value stays below the 2.0 m raster clearance to the nearest steep face

coverage.note: the probe measured the loop centre line at 0 / +/-1 m (coverage.json), not the 4 m gate line; no gate-width draw/collision coverage claim is made

coverage.rule: covered = declared draw triangle within 0.5 m of the collision height
coverage.note: the coverage test measured the 1151 unique loop samples at 0 / +/-1 m, not the 4 m gate lines

countdown.rule: input is held at zero until the countdown reaches GO; the timer starts at GO and the car is on the start line

rules.timer: elapsed engine ticks from GO at 1/60 s; it keeps running across a respawn and freezes on the third lap
rules.gateOrder: the start/finish line counts only on a forward crossing after at least half a lap; three laps end the race
rules.progress: progress is cumulative forward travel along the measured closed loop, clamped to three laps

respawn.target: the start/finish line point and its measured tangent heading (the last lap line)
respawn.rule: respawn when the chassis falls more than 1 m below the measured ground at its arc or stays airborne for 30 ticks, or leaves the declared band; the attempt timer keeps running and the lap count is kept

limits: the lap starts in collision component 510 (map-laps loop-01), not at the committed point-to-point spawn; the start is moved into the loop component and is not a gate-layout change
three laps of the measured 284.4524 m loop; the start/finish line is rules geometry only and no gate mesh is added to the render packet
the checkpoint gates are data only: the current LapRules counts three forward crossings of the start/finish line and does not require the checkpoints
no lap has been driven on this map; the 1.25 m respawn band is a declared rule, not a measured driven lateral bound
no opponents, no AI and no race audio

needed: map-registry.js needs an Amboy lap course entry (layoutUrl + courses) for ?map=amboy&course=lap
app.js must fetch this document for the lap course and pass it to createSprintRules; LapRules requires courseId "lap"
map-package.js validateMapPackage is the point-to-point 4-gate / 2060 m validator and must not be applied to this lap document
the e1-drive Amboy geometry packet must be loaded before the lap layout; this document carries no draw geometry
gate lines are rules geometry only; no gate mesh, start banner or race director exists for this map
props/power-ups/colliders are not measured by this probe
missingData: retail start-line / route record for the map (Level.levelphysics has a route count but routes are not parsed by the committed scanner)
draw coverage of the gate lines at their full 4 m width (coverage.json measured 0 / +/-1 m stations only)
decoded InstancedTriangleMesh collision shapes (excluded from the raster)
